paite: Gentheite ngaihtuahmi ahampha hi, mangbat ni in TOUPA'N amah ahumbit ding.
heading: David La / Dam louh Hun A Thumna

paite: TOUPA'N amah humbit in ahihhing ding a, lei ah vualzawl in a-om ding; amah doute'n ut-ut a abawl ding un ape kei ding.
TOUPA'N agimna lupna mun ah ahihhat ding a; nang achi anat lai in alupna na bawlsak vek zel hi.
"TOUPA aw, hon hehpih inla, ka hinna hihdam in, na tung ah thil ka hihkhial ngal a," ka chi a.
"Hon doute'n, chikchiang in asi in, amin amang diam aw!" chi in hon gensia uhi.
Alak ua kuahiam in ahong veh lai in, thu bangmah lou maimai agen zel a; alungtang in thulimlouhna alakhawm a; apawtkhiaktak in mi ahilh zel hi.
Hon ho tengteng hon gensia in akihuau ua; hon hihsiatna ding uh angaihtuah uhi.
Natna hoih loutak in amankipta, tua lum athounawn kei ding, achi ua.
Ahi, ka lawm kithuahpih theih, ka muantak, ka tanghou nekpih ngei in akhetul ka tung ah alikta hi.
Himahleh, TOUPA aw, nang hon hehpih inla, amau ka thuktheihna ding in hon kaithou nawn in.
Hiai ah ka tung ah na kipak chih ka thei hi, hon dou in ahon zoh louh ziak in.
Kei zaw lungsim hoihtak ka putna ah nangma'n na hon len tinten a, Na ma ah tangtawn a ding in na hon koih hi.
TOUPA, Israel' Pathian, tangtawn a kipan tangtawn pha in phat in om hen, Amen! Amen!
